# WordPress

- Project: https://wordpress.org
- **Not bundled:** WP-CLI downloads WordPress from wordpress.org (checksum verified by WP-CLI) into the folder of a new WordPress site.
- License: **GNU General Public License v2.0 or later** – https://wordpress.org/about/license/
- WEBit only adds a few lines to `wp-config.php` (address of the site, local environment); WordPress itself is not modified or redistributed by WEBit.
